_comment: Sample run config for gen-prompts.py --group ops (DM-Y, review fix F-05, 2026-10-27). Run sample01, env e2e-y-sample01, logins dmseed-<role> and ids are fakes: fill CPU from the R1 claims (gate OPS-G4) and TA from kits/<env> (the steward's kit actor, borrowed). No days: ops has no day rules. Supplied by the runner, the operator or the user, fake here: PORTAL_PROFILE and POMA_OPS_PROFILE (headed ops sign-ins, outside results/), PORTAL_ORG (organisation slug deploymate-<uuid>, OPS-G2), IGNORES_BASELINE (exact deephealthcheckIgnores value from OPS-G2, or 'no tenant override'). RUN_TAG = 8 characters [a-z0-9] whose throw-away names are free (OPS-G3). OPS_ROLE_PROFILES / SUITE_REPORT / MASTER_FLAG_OK carry their safe defaults (none / none / no); change them only after the user or operator decided (seed O2). Test: gen-prompts.py <this file> --group ops --dry-run (exit 0, no NEEDS CONFIG line); a real run adds --claims.
